question: During an automated mission, when does the Autel EVO Max 4N start RTH after losing signal?

intake.decided_by: code (single pass has no intake call)

brief.short_answer: RTH is triggered after the C2 link is lost and the Autel app shows a disconnection, and only if the configured Signal Loss action is Auto RTH (otherwise Hover or Land may apply). If the link is restored within about 10 seconds, control can return to the remote controller and RTH is aborted or not initiated depending on timing. During automated flights, the drone will continue attempting to reconnect and then execute the preset action when signal loss occurs.

sections.label: FAA guidance
sections.abstain_reason: no claims in the single-pass brief

claims.text: During automated flight, when the C2 link is lost the drone will continue attempting to reconnect and then execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect. If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller. If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected,” and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: The Signal Loss behavior options include Return to Home, Hover, and Land; Signal Loss Action options include Continue mission and Auto RTH.
claims.quote: The Signal Lost behavior options include Return to Home, Hover, and Land. Signal Lost behavior: Configure how the drone should respond when the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10

claims.text: During automated flight missions, if the connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost, the drone will continue flying in its current state until the Autel Enterprise App displays the disconnection message. Only then will the drone execute the preset Signal Loss Action.
claims.quote: During automated flight missions, if the connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost, the drone will continue flying in its current state until the Autel Enterprise App displays the disconnection message. Only then will the drone execute the preset Signal Loss Action.

claims.text: If the C2 link is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
claims.quote: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds (e.g., remote controller power-off), the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
